description: B3 HIP ROOF, the pitch edit 6/12 -> 8/12 (ROOF-HIP; docs/reference-parts/buildings.md B3 'Edits'): b3-hip-6-12's loft.roof 1.1.0 feature, Style Hip, at 8/12. model.json is EXACTLY the plugin's expansion with the member materials documents applies; members.json is each body's member metadata, pinned by packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_roof_hip.py and checked by services/geometry/tests/test_roof_hip_b3.py.
derivation: As b3-hip-6-12, at slope 8/12: a full seat would make a 2.333 heel, over 1/3 of the depth, so the seat is 2.75 and the heel 1.833; plumb depth 5.5 x 14.4222 / 12 = 6.610178, HAP 4.776845. Commons are B2's 8/12 rafter (line 85.632), jacks line 56.414 and 27.570 (28.844 apart), hips unit 18.76 and line 111.397, drop 0.353553.
surface_area 16299073.620479 mm^2 and centroid z 2809.103490 mm: the independent script's solids (x 72 in, y 60 in by symmetry). mass_g = volume x 450 kg/m^3; center_of_mass = centroid.
bounding_box: X -12..156, Y -12..132; Z from the hips' tail tips 85.533114 to the ridge's top 141.401844 in.
topology and mesh counts: as b3-hip-6-12 (the pitch moves no face).
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set: the kernel differs from the closed form by 6e-8 mm^3, from the script's area by 2.8e-8 mm^2 and its centroid by <= 1.2e-12 mm. 1e-6 is 17x the worst.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: KERNEL-LEVEL, measured 2026-10-17: OCCT's STEP writer rounds the sloped members' coordinates. Round-trip drift: volume +2.26e-4 mm^3 and area -1.02e-5 mm^2; centroid <= 1.5e-9 mm. The independent build123d twin drifts -1.01e-3 mm^3 through build123d's own export_step while its axis-aligned ridge drifts nothing (test_roof_hip_b3::test_the_roofs_step_drift_is_occts). 1e-3 is the roof goldens' bound, 4.4x this drift; volume and area only.
